name: Calibration Benchmark Runner
description: Measures register sensitivity per model by running a comprehensive benchmark suite across multiple linguistic registers (direct, casual, technical, academic, narrative). Evaluates model performance on 50+ tasks spanning factual recall, reasoning, code generation, analysis, creative writing, and instruction following. Produces calibrated ModelProfile artifacts with aggregate and per-category accuracy metrics.

types.name: CalibrationRunner

fields.name: _backend
fields.description: Backend instance providing complete() method for model invocation

fields.name: _cache
fields.description: Cache for storing and retrieving ModelProfile artifacts

types.description: Orchestrates the register sensitivity benchmark execution for a given model backend

functions.name: score_response
functions.description: Evaluates a model response against acceptance and rejection patterns defined in a benchmark task. Returns true if response contains accepted patterns without rejected patterns. For reasoning category tasks, presence of any reject pattern invalidates acceptance.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: Benchmark task dictionary containing 'accept', 'reject', and 'category' keys

preconditions: task contains 'accept' key with list of strings
task contains 'reject' key (may be empty list)
task contains 'category' key with string value
postconditions: Returns True if response contains any accept pattern AND no reject patterns
Returns False if response contains any reject pattern (especially for reasoning category)
Returns False if response contains no accept patterns

functions.name: __init__
functions.description: Initializes CalibrationRunner with a backend for model invocation and optional profile cache

inputs.name: profile_cache
inputs.description: Optional cache; defaults to new ProfileCache() if not provided

preconditions: backend implements complete(system, messages, max_tokens) method
postconditions: self._backend is set to provided backend
self._cache is set to provided profile_cache or new ProfileCache()

functions.name: run
functions.description: Executes synchronous calibration benchmark across all register transforms and tasks. For each (register, task) pair, applies register transform to prompt, invokes backend, scores response, and aggregates results. Computes per-register and per-category accuracies, constructs ModelProfile, saves to cache, and returns profile.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Canonical model identifier for the profile

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: Override benchmark tasks; defaults to BENCHMARK_TASKS (50+ tasks)

inputs.name: registers
inputs.description: Override registers to test; defaults to all 5 from REGISTER_TRANSFORMS

inputs.name: delay
inputs.description: Seconds to sleep between API calls (rate limiting)

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.description: Print progress and results to stdout

error_data.handling: Caught, logged if verbose, task marked as incorrect

preconditions: self._backend is not None and callable
If tasks provided, each task dict has 'category', 'prompt', 'accept', 'reject' keys
If registers provided, each register name exists in REGISTER_TRANSFORMS
postconditions: Returns ModelProfile with accuracies for all register/task combinations
ModelProfile.accuracies contains RegisterAccuracy for each tested register
ModelProfile.by_task contains TaskRegisterProfile for each unique category
ModelProfile is saved to cache via ProfileCache.put()
ModelProfile.calibrated_at is set to current UTC timestamp
side_effects: Invokes self._backend.complete() for each (register, task) pair
Sleeps 'delay' seconds between each backend call
Writes ModelProfile to cache storage via self._cache.put()
Prints progress and results to stdout if verbose=True

structured_side_effects.description: Invokes backend API for each (register, task) combination
Saves ModelProfile to cache via self._cache.put()
Prints progress, errors, and summary statistics when verbose=True

invariants: REGISTER_TRANSFORMS contains exactly 5 register transforms: direct, casual, technical, academic, narrative
BENCHMARK_TASKS contains 50 tasks across 6 categories: factual, reasoning, code, analysis, creative, instruction
Each task dict contains keys: category, prompt, accept (list), reject (list)
Delay between API calls is enforced via time.sleep()
requires: Register transforms produce valid prompt strings

data_access.rationale: Reads global benchmark configuration constants; writes calibration results to persistent cache
